Inner roundoff/CAD/stronger Mesh2/volume/PDE/engineering/manufacturing flags remain false; reference is the original analysis mesh, not OEM accuracy or factory tolerance.

actual_child_binding_rule: Root must bind all276 prepared inputs plus held/source-peer/root-test/prerequisite reviews in a fresh authorized actual assessment child, and verify its expected SHA at launch. The exact-child peer review is EXTERNAL in the outer launch guard: it must not be required inside that same child input map, because a peer which pins the child hash would create a self-referential hash cycle. The HELD template placeholder wording is clarified by this external rule; source code requires no change.
